biography:
Alex Seid hails from the bustling streets of São Paulo, Brazil, a city where the roar of engines is as familiar as the samba rhythm. Unlike many racers who grew up karting, Alex's entry into motorsport was serendipitous. At 16, while working part-time at a local garage, he impressed a visiting amateur racer with his mechanical aptitude and insightful observations about car setup. The racer, recognizing raw talent, offered Alex a spot on his team as a mechanic. One fateful practice day, with the team's driver sidelined by illness, Alex was thrust behind the wheel. He stunned everyone, setting lap times that rivaled the seasoned pro. 

His natural feel for the car and unwavering focus quickly propelled him through the ranks. He joined F.Inter MG-15 three years ago, a team with a reputation for nurturing young talent. While his results have been solid, consistently finishing in the points, a breakthrough win has remained elusive. He's known for his relentless work ethic, spending countless hours analyzing telemetry and honing his skills in the simulator. Alex's quiet determination and deep respect for the sport have earned him a devoted following among fans who admire his unwavering commitment to excellence.

Currently, Alex is focused on elevating his performance to the next level. He feels he is close to competing for podiums, and has been working closely with his engineer to fine tune his driving, and car setups.
drivingStyle: Alex possesses a smooth, calculated driving style, often described as 'metronomic.' He prioritizes consistency and tire management, preferring to build momentum throughout a race rather than aggressively attacking from the start. He excels in high-speed corners, carrying remarkable speed while maintaining precise control. While not the flashiest driver, his ability to consistently deliver quick lap times and minimize mistakes makes him a formidable competitor, especially in endurance races.

rivalries.reason: A bitter rivalry stemming from a controversial collision during a karting race in their youth. Ricardo has always viewed Alex as a threat, and their on-track battles are fiercely contested.

quirks: Always wears the same worn-out pair of driving gloves, believing they bring him luck.
Listens to a specific samba song by Elis Regina before every race to calm his nerves.
Meticulously polishes his helmet visor before each session, ensuring perfect visibility.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about instant gratification; it's about building something enduring, one lap at a time."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian National Karting Championship in 2016 after starting the final race in 12th position. He masterfully navigated the chaotic start and steadily climbed through the field, showcasing his exceptional racecraft.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a mechanical failure during the final lap of a F.Inter race while leading by a comfortable margin. The heartbreak of losing a certain victory taught him a valuable lesson about the unpredictable nature of motorsport.
